guide.summary: A leftovers eater that lives on the metabolite other feeders give off.
guide.biology: In real microbe communities, some cells feed on substances that their neighbours release, linking their lives together.
guide.rules: Eats metabolite only, using oxygen. Every oxygen-using feeder releases 0.20 metabolite for each carbon it eats, so Crossfeeders grow where others are already feeding. Moves 0.25 cells per second and senses food up to 2 cells away. Prey for Amoeba, Ciliate, Siltworm and others.
guide.example: Add Crossfeeders beside a patch of Sprinters on sugar and watch them follow the Sprinters' leftovers.
